description: Na₈Nb₂Cu₄S₂₁ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₂Cu₂S square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NbS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.14 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five S atoms to form distorted NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one NbS₄ tetrahedra, corners with three CuNaS₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ pentagonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NbS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CuNaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.06 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.22 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with eight CuNaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NbS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.13 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to four Cu and seven S atoms. There are two shorter (3.26 Å) and two longer (3.27 Å) Na-Cu bond lengths. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.12 Å. Nb is bonded to four S atoms to form NbS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ pentagonal pyramid, edges with two CuNaS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Nb-S bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded to one Na and four S atoms to form distorted CuNaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two CuNaS₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NbS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent CuNaS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaS₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Cu-S bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.36 Å. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded to one Na and four S atoms to form distorted CuNaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two CuNaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NbS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent CuNaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cu-S bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. There are eleven inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na and one Nb atom to form distorted SNa₄Nb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₂Cu₂S square pyramids, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Nb trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two S atoms. Both S-S bond lengths are 2.07 Å. In the third S site, S is bonded in a water-like geometry to two S atoms. The S-S bond length is 2.08 Å. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two Cu, and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.09 Å. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two S atoms. The S-S bond length is 2.10 Å. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Nb, and two Cu atoms. In the seventh S site, S is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Cu atom. In the eighth S site, S is bonded to two Na, two Cu, and one S atom to form distorted SNa₂Cu₂S square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaS₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Nb trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₄S trigonal bipyramid. In the ninth S site, S is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Cu atom. In the tenth S site, S is bonded to four Na and one S atom to form distorted SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₄S trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one SNa₂Cu₂S square pyramid, and edges with three equivalent SNa₄Nb trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh S site, S is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent S atoms.
